title: One of These Ethernet Switches Will Give Your Router the Ports You Need
summary: I got this switch to connect three Power over Ethernet (PoE) cameras recently. Make sure your switch has enough PoE ports (some switches have a mix of regular and PoE ports) and can handle your overall power requirements.
